# The OS table's rows as shipped (native/os_calls.json's rows with an ELF ordinal), one line each:
# ordinal, name, prototype. A module built against any of them calls them by
# ordinal forever, so a line here is never changed, moved or removed: a new
# row is a new last line, written with the row it freezes. tests/test_os_table.py
# holds the table to this.
0 open | int open(const char *path, int flags, ...)
1 close | int close(int fd)
2 read | ssize_t read(int fd, void *buf, size_t n)
3 write | ssize_t write(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n)
4 lseek | off_t lseek(int fd, off_t at, int whence)
5 stat | int stat(const char *path, struct stat *st)
6 fstat | int fstat(int fd, struct stat *st)
7 isatty | int isatty(int fd)
8 unlink | int unlink(const char *path)
9 mkdir | int mkdir(const char *path, mode_t mode)
10 rmdir | int rmdir(const char *path)
11 rename | int rename(const char *from, const char *to)
12 opendir | DIR *opendir(const char *path)
13 readdir | struct dirent *readdir(DIR *dir)
14 closedir | int closedir(DIR *dir)
15 getcwd | char *getcwd(char *buf, size_t n)
16 getenv | char *getenv(const char *name)
17 exit | void exit(int code)
18 _exit | void _exit(int code)
19 __errno | int *__errno(void)
20 time | time_t time(time_t *t)
21 clock_gettime | int clock_gettime(clockid_t clock, struct timespec *ts)
22 gettimeofday | int gettimeofday(struct timeval *tv, void *tz)
23 nanosleep | int nanosleep(const struct timespec *req, struct timespec *rem)
24 usleep | int usleep(useconds_t us)
25 sleep | unsigned sleep(unsigned s)
26 pthread_create | int pthread_create(pthread_t *thread, const pthread_attr_t *attr, void *(*start)(void *), void *arg)
27 pthread_join | int pthread_join(pthread_t thread, void **out)
28 pthread_detach | int pthread_detach(pthread_t thread)
29 pthread_self | pthread_t pthread_self(void)
30 pthread_exit | void pthread_exit(void *out)
31 pthread_mutex_init | int pthread_mutex_init(pthread_mutex_t *m, const pthread_mutexattr_t *attr)
32 pthread_mutex_destroy | int pthread_mutex_destroy(pthread_mutex_t *m)
33 pthread_mutex_lock | int pthread_mutex_lock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
34 pthread_mutex_trylock | int pthread_mutex_trylock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
35 pthread_mutex_unlock | int pthread_mutex_unlock(pthread_mutex_t *m)

37 moy_term_size | int moy_term_size(int *cols, int *rows)

42 munmap | int munmap(void *addr, size_t len)
43 socket | int socket(int domain, int type, int protocol)
44 bind | int bind(int fd, const struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t len)
45 listen | int listen(int fd, int backlog)
46 accept | int accept(int fd, struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t *len)
47 connect | int connect(int fd, const struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t len)
48 send | ssize_t send(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, int flags)
49 recv | ssize_t recv(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, int flags)
